routes.name: Long-term residence permit for the purpose of doing business
Permanent residence permit after 5 years of temporary residence

note: Czechia, read on the Ministry of the Interior's Official Information Portal for Foreigners (frs.gov.cz, ipc.gov.cz) on 2026-10-30. The Employee Card (a long-term residence permit for employment) is valid for at most 2 years, limited to the employment's or work permit's length; it is applied for in person at a Czech diplomatic mission or, by one already staying lawfully, at a Ministry office (either), extended in Czechia; CZK 2,500; decided in 60 days, 90 in especially complicated cases or where the Labour Office's binding opinion is asked (90 kept); the holder works in the post it was issued for and reports a change of employer (read as work for the sponsor). The long-term residence permit for doing business (a licensed trade, self-employment) is for the holder of a long-term business visa, or of a long-term residence permit with more than 5 years in Czechia, so it is applied for in Czechia after a visa from abroad; CZK 2,500, 60 days, at most 2 years. Permanent residence is open after 5 years' continuous residence (CZK 2,500, 1,000 under 15; 60 days); it is unlimited, its card issued for 10 years and extended. EU and EEA citizens' residence and naturalisation's years weren't read, so neither free movement nor which years count is written.

sources.title: Ministry of the Interior (frs.gov.cz), Employee Card
sources.said: How long is this type of residence permit valid for? Always for a maximum period of 2 years . ... What is the administrative fee? CZK 2,500. ... What is the time limit to process the application? 60 days; 90 days in especially complicated cases, or if the Ministry of the Interior asked the Labour Office for a binding opinion . ... How and where can you apply? Only in person at one of the Ministry of the Interior offices. ... You can only apply in person at one of the Czech Republic’s diplomatic missions

sources.title: Ministry of the Interior (frs.gov.cz), Long-term residence permit for the purpose of doing business
sources.said: if you are going to carry out business activities, a licensed trade, be self-employed, be a statutory body or a member of a statutory body of a trading company in the Czech Republic and you are: a holder of a long-term visa for the purpose of doing business or a holder of a long-term residence permit for any purpose and, at the same time, you have resided in the Czech Republic for more than 5 years. ... How long is this residence permit valid for? For a maximum of 2 years. ... What is the administrative fee? CZK 2,500. ... What is the time limit to process the application? 60 days.

sources.title: Ministry of the Interior (frs.gov.cz), Permanent residence permit after 5 years of temporary residence
sources.said: A permanent residence permit is a type of permit that is issued upon request to third countries nationals who on the day of application have resided in the Czech Republic continuously for at least 5 years. ... A permanent residence permit document is issued for 10 years ... What is the administrative fee? CZK 2,500, 1,000 for minors under 15 years of age. ... What is the time limit to process the application? 60 days.
